2085-2645-3230-3430.easyPrerequisites: Kelpie Guide doesn't have summoning sickness.
2085-2645-3230-3430.description:
Activate Coral Atoll by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, untapping Coral Atoll
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Kelpie Guide.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2946-4063-4871-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
2946-4063-4871-5670.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4063-4871-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Fleshtaker and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Fleshtaker trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

728-3175-8207.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

2586-3197-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Odric's Outrider triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability
Repeat

1339-4616-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-4616-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Repeat.

147-2292-5100.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2292-5100.description:
Cast Return Upon the Tide by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Return Upon the Tide.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Return Upon the Tide
Resolve the Return Upon the Tide copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

730-1479-2841-6926.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Vibrant Cityscape.
730-1479-2841-6926.description:
Fetch a land using Vibrant Cityscape.
When the fetched land enters, Emeria Angel and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Emeria Angel trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Angel from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Emeria Angel triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1479-2841-6754-8101.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Wooded Foothills.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-6754-8101.description:
Fetch a land using Wooded Foothills.
When the fetched land enters, Eusocial Engineering and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Eusocial Engineering trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Eusocial Engineering from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Eusocial Engineering triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2232-7827-7828-7837.easyPrerequisites: One of the Dwarves with mana value 1 must be on your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
2232-7827-7828-7837.description:
Cast the Dwarf with mana value 1 that's in your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the Dwarf enters, Cloudstone Curio and Thorin trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other Dwarf with mana value 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thorin trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R/W}.
Repeat.

2583-4636-6753.description:
Activate Whirler Virtuoso by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens due to Exalted Sunborn.
When the tokens enter, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

1594-4399-4518-4716.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Prosperous Innkeeper trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Prosperous Innkeeper trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1594-4399-4518-4716.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3132-3259-7297.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
3132-3259-7297.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3132-3259-7297.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Bladewing, triggering Breath of Fury and Bladewing.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

413-849-1263-4871.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Anax and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodsoaked Champion enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Repeat.

2034-7766-7767.description:
Cast Ultron either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {1}{U}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Ultron enters, Prowler triggers, causing it to connive.
Ultron triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 2/2 Robot Villain creature token.
When the Robot Villain enters, Prowler triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Robot Villain, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Prowler ability, causing it to connive.
Repeat from step 3.

511-817-3000-4050-7704.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

2034-3209-6753.description:
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by paying at most {4}{G}, creating two creature tokens and returning Sprout Swarm from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by paying at most {3} and tapping two creature tokens, creating two creature tokens and returning Sprout Swarm from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two tapped creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}
Repeat from step 2.
2034-3209-6753.notes: The starting cost can be reduced by tapping creatures to pay for Sprout Swarm using its convoke ability, and/or sacrificing those creatures to Ashnod's Altar.

2308-4050-4871-6823.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
2308-4050-4871-6823.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters, Aunt May triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {1}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Aunt May trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

323-4771-5220-6900.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

3652-5220-5226-6900.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Ornithopter
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Cast Ornithopter from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

4200-6406-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {1} and tapping Appa.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0} and tapping Appa and the Ally token.
Repeat from step 4.
4200-6406-6867.notes: If you control another creature, you can reduce the cost by {1} and tap that creature in step 3 instead of paying mana.

647-851-2457-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

914-2511-5140.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2511-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{B}.
Repeat.
914-2511-5140.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

277-5413-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
Lands you control and/or land cards in your graveyard that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
277-5413-5720-5721.description:
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1308-2457-2837-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 2/2 Cat creature tokens with haste.
Activate the Cats by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1350-2060-5508.manaNeeded: {4} available in at least three different colors
1350-2060-5508.description:
Cast Crystalline Crawler by paying {4}, ensuring to spend at least three different colors of mana to cast it, causing Crystalline Crawler to enter the battlefield with at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
When Crystalline Crawler enters the battlefield, Railway Brawler triggers, putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} and the remaining mana in any combination of color(s).
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Crystalline Crawler to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

1430-2947-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Mirror Image, adding one mana of any color.
When Mirror Image dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Vesperlark.
Repeat.

647-1365-3723-3944-5112.notablePrerequisites: Mairsil does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
647-1365-3723-3944-5112.description:
Activate Mairsil using Cauldron of Souls' ability by tapping it, giving itself persist until end of turn.
Activate Mairsil using Blood Pet's ability by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Mairsil dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Mairsil using Carnifex Demon's ability by paying {B} and removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on each other creature.
Repeat.

654-1021-2167-2653.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, adding {C}.
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Drownyard Temple enters the battlefield, Nissa and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Drownyard Temple.
Repeat.

3011-3946-4086.easyPrerequisites: Heartless Hidetsugu does not have summoning sickness.
3011-3946-4086.description: Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, causing it to deal lethal damage to each opponent with an even life total, nearly lethal damage to each opponent with an odd life total, and no damage to you due to Glacial Chasm.

527-2645.notablePrerequisites: Selvala does not have summoning sickness. You control a creature with power 6 or greater.
527-2645.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {5}{G}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Selvala.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
527-2645.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.
